text:
maya: Heads up — I'm opening a docs PR to refresh the Quickstart (hello app) flow. Goal: simplify auth explanation, add a tiny serverless ephemeral-key example, swap a few SDK snippets to v8 style, and fix the broken 'deploy' link. Need reviewers and a quick smoke test matrix.
ryan: 👍 can you keep the SDK snippet swap in a separate commit? easier to review and revert if needed.
nora: One ask — please add a minimal curl example for folks who skip the SDK. That's what most new users try first.
maya: Good call. I'll add a tiny curl snippet and a note about env var naming. Draft PR here: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4821 (WIP). I'll split into commits: (1) auth + tutorials, (2) SDK snippet update, (3) link fixes.
maya: Example curl I'll include:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY" \n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \n  -d '{"input":"hello world"}'
```
selma: Also update the Docker quickstart note — remind people to `EXPOSE 3000` in sample Dockerfile and show how to pass the env var: `docker run -e REDWOOD_API_KEY=... -p 3000:3000`.
docbot: deploy-bot: preview site build queued for PR 4821 — preview link will be available in ~10m: https://deploy-preview-4821--docs.redwood.ai
ryan: I'll pick up the SDK commit (the fetch->client rewrite). Can you add a short note about pinning model versions (to avoid silent regressions)?
maya: Good catch. I'll add a one-liner under "stability" recommending pinned model version in examples, and call out how to change it later. Also adding a tiny local smoke test: `npm ci && npm run start` then run the curl above.
nora: LGTM. Small nit: we standardized on `REDWOOD_API_KEY` across samples — keep that name, don't switch to `REDWOOD_KEY`.
maya: Yep, keeping REDWOOD_API_KEY. Tagging @selma to double-check the Docker wording before merge.
selma: Quick look — wording is fine. One extra recommended step: add a short sentence about clearing KV cache between runs when testing prompt/output changes (some folks hit stale prefix caching).
maya: Added the cache note and the test steps. I'll wait for the preview build and then merge if green. Thanks all :tada: 
ryan: Thanks — will review SDK snippet commit in the afternoon.
docbot: deploy-bot: preview for PR 4821 finished (status: success) — preview available: https://deploy-preview-4821--docs.redwood.ai
maya: Preview looks good, merging now. Follow-up issues: docs issue tracker #213 — migrate remaining examples to SDK v8 over next sprint.
ryan: Sounds good, assign me for the SDK batch.
maya: Done. Closing thread.
